paragraphs: In [Niddah 60b](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.60b.8-11) he expounded in Rav’s name that the halakhah follows Rabbi Nechemyah. Rav Nachman said to him: “Abba teaches … and you say …,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Niddah gives Rav Chiyya’s ruling in Rav’s name. Rav Nachman answers with the words “Abba teaches,” which Davidson renders “Father teaches.”
[Rashba](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashba_on_Niddah.60b.5) understands Abba here as Rav Nachman’s father. The linked continuation gives the case and the disagreement behind Rav Nachman’s objection.
